subject: Benefit semantics code/schema gap analysis ready for review
summary: Following Manager-02 deconfliction, 5f9d completed the implementation-gap sublane. Current BenefitFlow Beta cannot safely collapse real Canadian plan semantics into one maximum/period per category. Evidence-backed gaps include layered limits, anchored reset periods, person/family/practitioner/shared scopes, parent-child limits, contextual eligible-charge bases, shared deductible/OOP accumulators, and unsafe dense-block money heuristics. Recommendation: evolve toward evidence-linked typed constraints and limit-id accumulators; fail closed on unresolved number-to-rule relationships.
